book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: ME KOLINITA ꞌIDI LETA ꞌEBWEUNA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Ai manuna
Nuwanuwa nina ai manuna niꞌatu ꞌigu leta ꞌenaya wasimanena, ꞌenega ꞌaboꞌagu yaeonami ꞌaene boboꞌana tuga ꞌabo meꞌolotodi geyaꞌabo siaiai.

Ta esi nigeya sawesawemiya be maiboꞌami nadigega waguiguinuwaꞌesa, manuna yau wawasae taudi weweloedi siguiguinuwa besobeso. ꞌEnega nai ꞌilobwenemi waꞌeloai be ꞌenega ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna mamwanena, be geyaꞌabo guinuwa besobeso ꞌisinasinabwa ꞌemiya.
Be ꞌenega meꞌolotomi mwanemiyao ꞌidi nuwanuwa wada muliyedi. Wate nadigega ꞌomi mewainemi mwanemiyao ꞌidi nuwanuwa wada muliyedi.
Manuna ꞌabo waine ꞌiai, nigeya sawesawenaya be tauna oona ꞌiloine, ta esiya mwanenana meꞌolotona ꞌiloina. Wate tai, nigeya sawesawenaya be tauna oona ꞌiloine ta esiya mwanena mewainena ꞌida loine.

Ta wate geyaꞌabo waꞌenoꞌeno dumaduma mwanemiyao ꞌediyega. Nate namo ꞌabo siteluwa ꞌemiyega ꞌidi nuwanuwa leleleya be ꞌasiyata nigeya yauna ꞌediya sida sidasida Yaubada ꞌenaya be muliyega wate sida ꞌenoluwa limana, ta geyaꞌabo wamiyamiya dumaduma wawasae, ꞌabona nai yalakwaiyao ꞌemiya siapwesa be ꞌediyega Seitani ꞌitoo be ꞌimi ai ꞌigietoꞌumaliyedi.
ꞌAbo nuwanuwami be waaai, boboꞌana, ta geyaꞌabo yaloiloinemi ꞌaene maiboꞌami wada ai,

manuna nuwanuwagu be ꞌaene geyaꞌabo waaiai, nadigega ꞌaboꞌagu nigeya yaaiai, ta saꞌi maiboꞌada ꞌida miya dumadumadi Yaubada niꞌatu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeda, be ꞌaima ꞌamiyamiya weweloe ta ma ima gwausowala, ta ꞌaimi waaai.
ꞌEnega ꞌomi weweloemi be kwabulao ꞌami emataluwa gete, ꞌabo nigeya waaiai, nai boboꞌana be nadigega tuga wada miyami, ꞌaboꞌagu nadigega.
Ta ꞌabo nuwanuwami be waaai, boboꞌana, wada ai tuga, be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo yalakwaiya ꞌigiegie toꞌumaliyemi.
Ta ꞌomi toai ꞌInapwana ꞌina loina yasimana ꞌemiya ꞌaene geyaꞌabo wasaꞌisaꞌila.

Ta ꞌabo yaita waine mwanena lowa ꞌisaꞌilena ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌeluwa boboꞌadi simiyami, nate ꞌabo waine nina tebweuna ꞌimiyami be geyaꞌabo ꞌiaiai limana, ta boboꞌana wate ꞌabo ꞌiila limana mwanena ꞌenaya. Ta tai mwanediyao geyaꞌabo sisaꞌisaꞌiledi.

Gete wate ꞌaina nuwanuwa ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌeguyega, ta nigeya ꞌInapwana ꞌina loinega, nate ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo meꞌolotoyo mwaneyo nigeya ꞌiemiemisa Yaubada ꞌenaya, ta ꞌina nuwanuwa nadigega be maꞌiyayo wamiyami tuga, geyaꞌabo ꞌusaꞌisaꞌile.
Wate nadigega ꞌabo ꞌebweu waine ꞌoyo mwaneyo nigeya ꞌiemiemisa Yaubada ꞌenaya, ta nuwanuwana be maꞌiyayo wamiyami tuga, geyaꞌabo ꞌusaꞌisaꞌile.

ꞌAbo yaita tai nai waine ꞌabo mwanena nigeya ꞌiemiemisa Yaubada ꞌenaya, ta esi maꞌiyana tuga simiyami, ꞌiabe toemisa nina mwanena ꞌigieboboꞌane, ta ꞌenega natudiyao sena ꞌesasena ꞌena simimiya. Ta ꞌabo sisaꞌila, ꞌiabe natudiyao simiya toꞌumali.
Ta ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo mwaneyo nigeya Yaubada ꞌena ꞌiemiemisa ta nuwanuwana be ꞌisaꞌileyo, ꞌuda gisine ta geyaꞌabo ꞌuegagale. Manuna Yaubada nuwanuwana be wamiya siwalowa, ta geya nuwana egewagewana.
ꞌOyo tai nai waine ꞌetamo mwaꞌadega, mwaneyo ꞌugiesana ileꞌese, ꞌabo ꞌugiyai? ꞌIyaugwa! Nigeya tamwalamwalatoni, aga?”
ꞌIda ꞌebemiya be ꞌida ꞌebe paisewa Yaubada ꞌiloiloinedi
ꞌIda paisewa Yaubada niꞌatu ꞌieguyaiyena ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌedaya, ꞌenega ꞌebe paisewa nidi ꞌediya tada miyami. Gete nadigega ꞌigu loina toekalesiyao sena maiboꞌana ꞌediya.
ꞌAbo yaita ꞌoyo goma Yudia ta me Yudia ꞌida weꞌiweꞌiyaya lowa sidabena
bwalamuya ga muliyega Yesu Keliso ꞌena ꞌuemisa, geyaꞌabo ꞌunuwanuwa mwau me Yudia ꞌida weꞌiweꞌiyaya nina manuna. Ta wate ꞌabo nigeya weꞌiweꞌiyaya nina ꞌemuya, geyaꞌabo ꞌulodalodaba,
manuna lodaba nigeya yage sinabwana, ta yage sinabwana esiya Yaubada ꞌina loinao ꞌadi ematamatana.
Geyaꞌabo ꞌimi miya nai ꞌimi paisewa baleꞌuya manudi wanuwanuwa mwau, be ꞌaene nuwanuwami wasaꞌugelasa.

ꞌAbo yaita ꞌoyo ꞌebweu tai sinabwana manuna ꞌuguiguinuwa tuta nina ꞌuekalesiya, geyaꞌabo ꞌunuwanuwa mwau ꞌimu paisewa daita nina manuna, ta esi ꞌeguma ꞌimu taubada nina maꞌetamo ꞌitagwaleyo be ꞌuila ꞌimu ꞌasaya, boboꞌana ꞌuda ila tuga.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, topaisewao baleꞌuya ꞌabo Keliso ꞌena siemisa, Yaubada sawesawenaya ꞌidi toꞌumalinao ꞌediyega ꞌiliꞌamidi, ta wate tai sinabwadi ꞌabo Keliso ꞌena siemisa, sida etoꞌaliꞌei tauna manuna.
Manuna Keliso nina ꞌiemaisida ga ꞌaboꞌada ꞌina bodao. ꞌEnega geyaꞌabo watagwatagwalemi mali taubadao ꞌediya.
ꞌEnega gosegwao, geyaꞌabo ꞌimi ꞌebemiya nina waguiguitoyasedi. ꞌAbo toꞌase ꞌimi ꞌebemiya tuta nina Yaubada ꞌibwauyemi ga waekalesiya, ꞌebemiya nidi tuga ꞌediya wada miyami, Yaubada maꞌemi.
Taudi gomagweineyao be kwabulao ꞌadi loina
Nigeya ꞌebweu wate loina Yaubada ꞌiꞌebwaꞌebwaꞌegu gomagweineyao taudi nigeya siaiai manudi, ta esi ꞌiobobomegu ga nuwanuwa palupaluna ꞌiꞌebwaꞌegu yage gete manuna.
ꞌEnega tuta ꞌebe esilae gete ꞌenaya ꞌida ꞌebemiya gete tuga ꞌena tada miyami.
Ta ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo ꞌuaiya, mamwaneyo wada miyami tuga. Ta ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo nigeya ꞌuaiai, geyaꞌabo wate waine ꞌuꞌebeꞌebese.
Ta ꞌabo yaisigedi niꞌatu siai nate nigeya loegesi, ta esi aiai nidi ꞌidi paisewa sinabwana, ꞌenega nuwanuwagu be yagie kapekapeyanemi.
Manuna tuta mwauna baleꞌuya niꞌatu ꞌiloselabena, ꞌenega ꞌomi aiai nimi ꞌilobwenemi be wabubuna nadigega taudi nigeya siaiai.
Ta ꞌomi todedoi wada bubuna nadigega taudi nigeya sidedoi, ta wate ꞌomi togwausowala wada bubuna nadigega tonuwamwau. Nadigega wate ꞌomi toegimwane wada bubuna nadigega gomagomabesodi,
be wate geyaꞌabo baleꞌu gete yagenao manudi wanuwanuwa wawasae, manuna tuta gidalina be sisasawala be baleꞌu gete ꞌigugumwala.

ꞌEnega nuwanuwagu be geyaꞌabo yage baleꞌu manudi wanuwanuwa wawasae, ta esi wada bubuna nadigega taudi nigeya siaiai. Manuna taudi nigeya siaiai Yaubada ꞌina guinuwa namo manuna sinuwanuwa sinabwana, ta nuwanuwadi be ꞌInapwana sida giegwausowali.
Ta taudi aiai nidi baleꞌu yagenao nuwanuwadi be ꞌaene ꞌediyega mwanediyao sigiegwausowalidi.

ꞌEnega nigeya kapekapeyana be ꞌeda ꞌeluwa nidi ꞌediyega sitautauya. Ta wate gomagweineyao be iine taudi nigeya siaiai, sawesawediya be Yaubada manuna sinuwanuwa sinabwana, be ꞌenega bwaladi ta yaluyaluwadi sida gieꞌesasedi, ta esi aiai nidi sinuwanuwa yage baleꞌu manudi be ꞌaene ꞌediyega mwanediyao sigiegwausowalidi.
ꞌIgu simana gete ꞌenega nigeya ai yaꞌetoꞌetobode, ta esi sabi lememi, be Yaubada ꞌina guinuwa ꞌediya wada guinuwa ꞌaiꞌaila, ta geyaꞌabo mali yage manudi wanuwanuwa.

ꞌAbo yaita tai natuna gomagweinena ꞌiegagale be geyaꞌabo ꞌiaiai, ta esi ꞌabo natunana ꞌinuwamwau, manuna niꞌatu ꞌiewaine ta nuwanuwana be ꞌebweu tai maꞌiyana siai, tamana ꞌida tagwala tuga ꞌidi ai manuna, manuna ai nigeya yage toꞌumalina.

Ta esi ꞌabo tai ꞌinuwapaꞌali be ꞌaene natunana geyaꞌabo ꞌiaiai ta ꞌabo natunana sawesawenaya be ꞌiꞌalamaꞌiꞌitana be geyaꞌabo ꞌiaiai, ta wate ꞌabo nigeya yaita ꞌediyega ꞌinuwanuwa mwau ꞌetoboda gete manuna, nate boboꞌana wawasae, ꞌabo gomagweine nina geyaꞌabo ꞌiaiai.
ꞌEnega ꞌabo yaita ꞌina gomagweine ꞌitagwale be ꞌiai nate boboꞌana, ta ꞌabo ꞌiegagale nate boboꞌana wawasae.
Ta ꞌabo yaita waine aiai nina niꞌatu mwanena maꞌiyana sieꞌebweu ta ꞌabo tai ꞌimwawasa, waine nina sawesawenaya be ꞌiai limana. Nate namo ꞌilobwenena be Yaubada ꞌina tai ꞌebweuna maꞌiyana siai.
Ta esi yanuwena ꞌaene ꞌabo waine nina tebweuna ꞌimiyami, be geyaꞌabo ꞌiaiai limana, nate boboꞌana wawasae. Ta nai Yaubada Yaluyaluwana ꞌina nuwanuwa gete nadigega.
